title: Flat, rough-edged, exact palette — against what ships today
question: Both notes are in: no shading at all now, and the outline wanders instead of being circular. This is the one that matters — is it better than what ships today, or not yet?
context_md: Same stand, same frame, same 14,857 plant cells, no simulation change. One arm is the shipped 1:1 render magnified 3x; the other draws the same cells at 3 pixels each. Every fill is now a colour the engine already drew (snapped to the cells underneath, so the palette is exact), the threshold that cuts the outline wanders with position so nothing is a circular arc, and both the ambient-occlusion and the directional-light terms you called 3d-ish are off.
